_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json
_meta.description: Slice 07 of the bookkeeping-waterschappen-bbv-variant chain replaces the bare schema-driven detail page slice 04 declared for BudgetBBVMappingDetail with the bespoke kind=page custom component (BudgetBBVMappingDetail.vue) — the GL Account + BBV Programme pickers, the live per-account allocation feedback, the audit-trail sidebar, and the confirm-gated delete dialog do not fit the built-in `detail` page type. ADR-037 deep-merge unions on `id` so this fragment overlays slice 04 cleanly: page id BudgetBBVMappingDetail is re-declared with type=custom (kind=page) and the same route (/budget-mappings/:id). A second page entry is registered under the legacy id `BudgetMappingDetail` for backward compatibility with the slice-05 BBVProgrammeTable row drill-through, which navigates by router name. The manifest fragment for slice 04 is left untouched so the index page + nav entry remain in place.
